tagline: A colourful cube. Drag a face to turn it. Race the same scramble.
description:
Turn the faces of a cube until each side is one colour. Drag a face to twist it, or drag the empty space to spin the whole cube. Start at 3×3, or pick any size from a pocket 2×2 up to 10×10.

Scramble shuffles the cube. Restore puts it back to solved, if you would rather start over. Your move count sits in the corner while you work.

Send the invite from the GifOS bar and everyone who opens it gets the same scramble. First to a solved cube wins. On your own it is still just the toy: scramble, turn, solve.

An unofficial port of rubiks-cube by pengfeiw, MIT-licensed. This copy adds the scramble, a shared-shuffle race, and drag that works with a finger.
